scenes.text: Bad news. Somebody filmed you at the high-roller craps table last night screaming 'DADDY NEEDS A NEW CAGE' and slapping a whale on the back so hard he dropped his chips. The video is called 'Fight Boss Loses It'. It's everywhere.
scenes.speaker: Your PR director, Tiffani

choices.label: Laugh it off on a podcast
choices.result: You go on The Joe Brogan Experience for four hours. You talk about the casino for 40 minutes and elk meat for 3 hours and 20.

choices.label: Apologize to the whale
choices.result: The whale accepts your apology and asks to invest in the promotion. He is now a minority owner. Of a casino.

choices.label: Double down: book a VIP craps night at the next event
choices.result: 'Craps & Cagefights' sells out. The commission is going to need to see some paperwork.

scenes.text: Mr. President, it's the casino. Friendly call. You signed some markers last month. {$debt} worth. We'd love to discuss repayment, or 'a mutually beneficial partnership'.
scenes.speaker: Casino host Vinnie

choices.label: Pay it off personally
choices.result: You pay. Your spouse finds the bank statement. That's a separate storyline.

choices.label: Make the casino the official sponsor instead
choices.result: 'Lucky Buck Casino: Official Gaming Partner.' The commission is going to need to see some more paperwork.

scenes.text: {reporter.name} from {reporter.outlet} ambushes you in the parking garage with a camera and a question about fighter pay. You respond with a word that rhymes with 'duck'. He asks a follow-up. You respond with the same word, louder.
scenes.speaker: {reporter.name}

choices.label: Apologize publicly
choices.result: You apologize. He accepts. He also publishes the footage.

choices.label: Ban {reporter.name} from all events
choices.result: Banned. The Streisand effect kicks in immediately. {reporter.name}'s next story is about you banning him. It does huge numbers.

choices.label: Challenge him to a charity boxing match
choices.result: The charity match happens. You lose. By KO. The charity raises $2M. Worth it?

scenes.text: {reporter.name} is outside the venue in a fake moustache and a lanyard that says 'Bob from Catering'. Security wants to know what to do.
scenes.speaker: Your head of security

choices.label: Let him in. It's funnier.
choices.result: He covers the event in the moustache. It becomes his signature look.

choices.label: Throw him out
choices.result: Security escorts Bob from Catering out. The video gets 5 million views.

scenes.text: A screenshot of your group chat with the matchmakers has leaked. Your messages include 'these guys would fight for a sandwich', 'book the guy with the big chin, he never dies', and nine skull emojis.
scenes.title: SCREENSHOT (LEAKED)

choices.label: Claim it's fake
choices.result: 'Fake.' Several fighters post screenshots of you sending them the exact same emojis.

choices.label: Apologize to the roster
choices.result: You give a speech in the locker room. It's surprisingly heartfelt. Someone films it. It also leaks.

choices.label: Find the leaker
choices.result: Somebody in your building is talking. You will find them.

scenes.text: A senator wants you to appear at a rally. 'Big fan, big fan. Love the fights. Would love you to say a few words. And maybe the Fight Boss endorsement?' He sounds like a man who has never watched a fight.
scenes.speaker: Senator Dick Ballsworth

choices.label: Go to the rally
choices.result: You speak for six minutes. You say 'I'll put them all in the cage' twice. The crowd loves it. Half your audience is now furious.

choices.label: Decline politely
choices.result: You decline. He endorses a slap league instead.

scenes.text: The Senate Commerce Committee 'requests' your testimony regarding fighter pay, brain injuries and 'the promotion's relationship with Senator Ballsworth'.
scenes.title: CONGRESSIONAL SUMMONS

choices.label: Testify honestly
choices.result: You tell the truth for three hours. Nobody has ever seen a promoter do that. The board is horrified.

choices.label: Testify like it's a press conference
choices.result: You call a senator 'a bum' on live TV. Your approval rating goes up. Not with the senators.

scenes.text: A political consultant in a vest is in your office. 'Polls show you at 38% for an open Senate seat. People like a guy who yells. You yell. Let's talk.'
scenes.speaker: Consultant Chet

choices.label: Run for office (this ends your career here)
choices.result: You announce your candidacy at a weigh-in. You punch a cardboard cutout of your opponent. It's over. It's just beginning.

choices.label: Stay in the fight business
choices.result: 'I already run something more important than the country.'

scenes.text: A man in a tracksuit pitches you: 'Slap fighting. Two guys, one table, no defense. You just... take it. Costs nothing to produce. Ratings are insane.' His face is visibly swollen.
scenes.speaker: Slap promoter Dusty

choices.label: Launch the slap league
choices.result: 'POWER SLAP SHOWDOWN presented by {promotion}.' Doctors draft a joint letter. The ratings arrive before the letter.

choices.label: Absolutely not
choices.result: You pass. Dusty slaps himself on the way out. For practice.

scenes.text: A network wants a reality show: 16 prospects in a house, one contract. 'We'll need conflict. Like, a lot of it. We'll handle the alcohol budget.'
scenes.speaker: Network producer Kendra

choices.label: Make the show
choices.result: 'The Ultimate Fighter Who Lives In A House' is greenlit. The house has a pool. The pool will be a problem.

choices.label: Pass
choices.result: They make it with a rival. The rival's prospects become famous.

scenes.text: A beverage executive with very white teeth wants to launch 'BOSS JUICE', an energy drink with your face on it. '400mg of caffeine. Legally that's fine. Ethically that's fine. Medically we're still checking.'
scenes.speaker: BevCo executive

choices.label: Launch BOSS JUICE
choices.result: BOSS JUICE launches. It tastes like a battery dipped in Skittles. It sells out.

choices.label: Pass
choices.result: The drink launches with someone else's face on it. A slap fighter's.

scenes.text: A celebrity boxing influencer has posted a video calling you 'a bald thumb who pays fighters in exposure'. It has 40 million views. He's challenging you to a fight. Or a 'debate'. Or a podcast. Whatever gets clicks.

choices.label: Respond with a diss video
choices.result: Your diss video is three minutes long and mostly you yelling in a parking lot. It does huge numbers.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.result: Silence. He makes four more videos about your silence.

scenes.text: A fan account posted an edited photo of you with a full head of hair. 2 million likes. The caption: 'the president if he paid fighters'. Your own staff are sharing it.

choices.label: Post it yourself with 'lol'
choices.result: Self-deprecation. The internet briefly respects you.

choices.label: Demand it be taken down
choices.result: The Streisand effect strikes again. It's now on a billboard.

scenes.text: It's your spouse. 'Do you know what today is?' You do not know what today is. 'It's our anniversary. You're at a weigh-in in Tulsa. AGAIN.'
scenes.speaker: Your spouse

choices.label: Fly home immediately (miss the event)
choices.result: You fly home with flowers bought at the airport. They're from a vending machine. It's the thought that counts.

choices.label: Send something expensive
choices.result: A bracelet. It says 'sorry' in diamonds. Diamonds can't fix everything, but they can fix some things.

choices.label: 'I'm building an empire, babe'
choices.result: Silence on the line. Then a dial tone. That dial tone will cost you.

scenes.text: Your spouse has moved out and hired a divorce lawyer named Gloria who is known in legal circles as 'The Guillotine'. Her retainer letter is printed on black paper.
scenes.title: LETTER FROM COUNSEL

choices.label: Couples therapy ({$fee})
choices.result: The therapist asks you to 'leave the business at the door'. You bring the business to every session.

choices.label: Lawyer up
choices.result: Your lawyer is good. Hers is The Guillotine.

scenes.text: Final settlement: your ex gets the house, the boat, half your personal wealth, and the dog, whose name was 'Main Event'.
scenes.title: DIVORCE DECREE

choices.label: Sign
choices.result: Divorced. You buy a condo with a view of an arena. You eat cereal for dinner.

scenes.text: Tuition notice from Westbrook Academy: {$fee} for the semester, plus a 'voluntary' contribution to the new lacrosse pavilion. Your kid has been suspended twice for 'demonstrating rear-naked chokes'.
scenes.title: TUITION NOTICE

choices.label: Pay it
choices.result: Paid. The lacrosse pavilion will have your name on a brick.

choices.label: Move the kid to public school
choices.result: Your kid is thrilled. Public school has a wrestling team.

scenes.text: Your teenager walks into your office with a mouthguard. 'I want to be a fighter. I've been training at {fighter.gym} with {fighter.first} for three months.' {fighter.first} is standing behind them, looking guilty.
scenes.speaker: Your kid

choices.label: Support it
choices.result: Your kid wins their first amateur bout. You cry harder than you have at any event you've promoted.

choices.label: Absolutely not
choices.result: 'I've seen what this does to people.' You've also profited from what this does to people. Your kid points this out.

scenes.text: Your business manager is here with brochures: a yacht, a jet share, and a watch that 'tells time in four dimensions'. 'You've earned it. Also people will respect you more. Probably.'
scenes.speaker: Your business manager

choices.label: Go full whale (yacht, jet, watch)
choices.result: You are now a man with a yacht. You get seasick. You keep the yacht.

choices.label: A modest upgrade
choices.result: A nicer car. A nicer watch. Same bald head.

choices.label: Stay humble
choices.result: You keep driving the 2009 truck. The fighters respect it. Your spouse does not.

scenes.text: An email arrives: 'BECOME A LICENSED MMA REFEREE IN 6 WEEKS! 100% ONLINE! Endorsed by Nerm Bean.' You hover over the link for an unusually long time.
scenes.title: EMAIL

choices.label: Enroll (secretly)
choices.result: You pass the final exam. The final exam was a single question: 'Is he OK?' The correct answer was 'let him fight'.

choices.label: Delete the email
choices.result: Deleted. But you'll think about it.

scenes.text: A delegation from the Kingdom of Qasr sits in your office. They do not blink. 'His Excellency would like to buy your promotion. All of it. And you. Name a number. Then add a zero. Then we add another.'
scenes.speaker: Royal envoy

choices.label: Sell everything (this ends your career here)
choices.result: You sign. A golden pen. A golden cage. A passport you are not allowed to use.

choices.label: Host one mega-event there instead
choices.result: One event. The site fee alone is more than your first five years combined. Human rights groups send you a very long email.

choices.label: Decline
choices.result: You decline. The envoy smiles in a way that suggests 'for now'.
